text: The U.S. stock market is experiencing mixed trading today as investors weigh rising oil prices against anticipation for major technology earnings. While the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 have shown modest gains, the Nasdaq Composite has faced pressure, with utilities, energy, and materials sectors leading the market while technology and communication services lag. This volatility is largely driven by concerns over inflation and potential supply disruptions in the Middle East, which have pushed crude oil prices to one-month highs.
